handoff.lastActionSummary: Iteration 13 completed the Browser Extension Bridge UX refactor: extension icon now opens popup/settings instead of snapshot capture, badge/heartbeat/status are visible to daemon and widget, approved-site auto-observe plus command polling removes the manual snapshot step, site permission/restricted states are explicit, Browser UI hides adapter/debug complexity behind diagnostics, and Browser Bridge smoke/dogfood evidence is recorded.
openIssues: Codex app-server protocol remains experimental; stale persisted thread ids fall back safely, but live cross-process resume behavior needs dogfooding validation.
Browser store account submission is deferred until after dogfooding.

Vision recording/screen streaming has consent, retention, history, cleanup, skipped-frame diagnostics, resource guardrails, and Vision Context capsule preprocessing; longer CPU/memory tuning remains dogfood-dependent.
Vision Context real local ASR production backend remains behind the transcription sidecar interface until dogfooding chooses the first installed model/runtime.
Mascot motion must be reworked with real authored pose/expression/state animation assets; generated static-pose sprites are not accepted.

Browser Action native desktop executable browser chrome control is BLOCKED on a scoped Windows UI Automation or bounded native input helper; current adapter reports browser-window diagnostics, attempted PowerShell enumeration, required helper scope, and unsupported-action errors.

Browser Action custom Codex app-server tool bridge is BLOCKED on a stable app-server custom tool/client-tool contract; current coverage uses daemon prompt/tool simulation, protocol events, approval, audit, and widget-context visibility.
Restricted browser pages remain subject to browser/extension/CDP security boundaries and should report unsupported state rather than bypassing protections.
Browser Bridge uses explicit site permission for automatic page context sharing; users must enable each site or opt into broader origin permissions through extension settings.
